title: Megatron-LM: Training Multi-Billion Parameter Language Models Using Model Parallelism
authors: M. Shoeybi, M. Patwary, R. Puri, P. LeGresley, J. Casper, B. Catanzaro
before: Models were trained by copying the whole model onto each GPU.
problem: Past a few billion parameters, the model no longer fits on one device at all.
breakthrough: Split individual layers across GPUs with carefully placed communication, reaching 8.3B parameters on 512 GPUs.
why: The engineering that made the scaling era physically possible. Almost every large model since uses this or its descendants.
next: ZeRO complemented it; together they trained MT-NLG, PaLM and beyond.
inherits: Tensor parallelism, still part of every frontier training stack.
